company_name: CETC Electronics Equipment Group Co., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — CETC Equipment specializes in integrated circuit manufacturing equipment and third-generation semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: CETC Electronics Equipment Group Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and industrialization of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly for integrated circuits and third-generation semiconductors. The company has developed capabilities for both 8-inch and 12-inch integrated circuits and offers a range of microelectronic process equipment.

regional_presence.China: CETC Equipment is headquartered in the Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area and is a key player in the national semiconductor equipment sector.
